description: This file defines a validation rule class named TimezoneOffset within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract rule and validates whether a given timezone offset is within the acceptable range (-12 to +14).

classes.name: TimezoneOffset
classes.description: A validation class that checks if a timezone offset is within the valid range (-12 to +14).

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the provided input is a numeric value within the valid timezone offset range.
